category.title: Glutes
category.intro: Programmes that strengthen the big glute muscle and the side hip muscles. You start with the bridge, progress to the single-leg bridge and hip thrust, and from there to single-leg moves.
science: The side hip muscle works most in side-lying leg raises, and the big glute muscle most in single-leg squats and single-leg forward bends (EMG study).
In a 9-week study, hip thrusts and squats grew the glutes by a similar amount; squats grew the thighs more.
A move working a muscle more in the moment doesn't mean it will grow that muscle more; that's why the programme combines different moves.
Strong glutes help stop your knees caving in and support your lower back.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.setup: Lie on your back, knees bent, soles of your feet on the floor hip-width apart. Arms by your sides.
steps: Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips off the floor; form a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Keep your glutes tight at the top.
Lower slowly.
exercises.tip: Press through your heels; you can lift your toes slightly.

exercises.name: Bridge Hold
exercises.setup: Come up into the bridge position: hips up, a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
steps: Keep your glutes tight.
Don't let your hips drop.
Keep breathing and hold.
exercises.tip: If you feel a cramp in your hamstrings, bring your feet closer to your hips.

exercises.name: Bridge March
exercises.setup: Come up into the bridge position and keep your hips up.
steps: Without letting your hips drop, lift one knee towards your chest.
Put that foot down and lift the other knee.
Keep alternating as if marching.
exercises.tip: Don't let your hips rock side to side; keep them at the same height.
exercises.mistake: Don't let your hips drop when you lift your knee.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Bridge
exercises.setup: Lie on your back, bend one knee with that foot on the floor. Stretch the other leg out straight.
steps: Press through the heel on the floor to lift your hips; keep the extended leg in line with your body.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly; switch legs halfway through.
exercises.tip: Try it once you can do 20 normal bridges comfortably.
exercises.mistake: Don't let your hips drop to one side.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.setup: Rest your upper back on the edge of a sturdy sofa or a chair placed against a wall. Knees bent, feet on the floor.
steps: Squeeze your glutes and push your hips up; your body and thighs should be flat like a table.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and pause briefly.
Lower your hips slowly.
exercises.tip: Tuck your chin slightly towards your chest; look towards your knees.
exercises.mistake: Don't rise by arching your lower back instead of squeezing your glutes.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
exercises.setup: Hip thrust position; lift one leg into the air.
steps: Press through the heel on the floor and push your hips up.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly; switch legs halfway through.
exercises.tip: Keep both sides of your hips at the same height.
exercises.mistake: Don't swing up using the leg in the air.

exercises.name: Donkey Kick
exercises.setup: Get on all fours: hands under your shoulders, knees under your hips.
steps: Keeping one knee bent at 90 degrees, push that heel towards the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes when your thigh is parallel to the floor.
Lower slowly; switch legs halfway through.
exercises.tip: Imagine pressing the sole of your foot into the ceiling.
exercises.mistake: Don't arch your lower back; let the movement come from the hip.

exercises.name: Clamshell
exercises.setup: Lie on your side with your head on your lower arm. Bend your knees forward, feet and knees stacked.
steps: Keeping your feet together, open your top knee.
Pause briefly at the top without rolling your hips back.
Close slowly; switch sides halfway through.
exercises.tip: Keep the movement small; you should feel a burn at the side of your hip.

exercises.name: Side-Lying Leg Raise
exercises.setup: Lie on your side, legs straight and stacked. Rest your head on your lower arm, top hand on the floor in front.
steps: Keeping your top leg straight, lift it up; toes pointing forward.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly; switch sides halfway through.
exercises.tip: Lifting the leg slightly backwards works the side hip muscle more.
exercises.mistake: Don't turn your toes up to the ceiling; don't roll your hips back.

exercises.name: Standing Kickback
exercises.setup: Face a wall and put your hands on it. Lean forward slightly.
steps: Keeping one leg straight, extend it backwards.
Pause briefly while squeezing your glutes.
Bring it back slowly; switch legs halfway through.
exercises.tip: You don't need to lift the leg high; feel your glutes tighten.
exercises.mistake: Don't swing the leg up by arching your lower back.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.target: Glutes and front of the thighs
steps: Take a big step back with one foot and lower by bending both knees.
Stop when your back knee nears the floor.
Push through your front heel to return to the start; switch legs halfway through.
exercises.tip: Leaning your body slightly forward works the glutes more.
exercises.mistake: Don't let your front knee cave in.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Forward Bend
exercises.target: Big glute muscle, hamstrings and balance
exercises.setup: Stand on one leg with your knee slightly bent.
steps: As you lean your body forward, extend the other leg backwards; body and leg form one line.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstring.
Squeeze your glutes to return upright; switch legs halfway through.
exercises.tip: If your balance is shaky, support yourself with one hand on a wall.
exercises.mistake: Don't round your back; don't let your hip open to the side.

exercises.name: Sumo Squat
exercises.setup: Stand with your feet wide, toes pointing out. Bring your hands together at your chest.
steps: Keeping your body upright, open your knees out and lower down.
Keep your knees over your toes.
Squeeze your glutes as you stand up.
exercises.tip: Giving your glutes an extra squeeze at the top shifts the move towards the glutes.
exercises.mistake: Don't let your knees cave in.
